title: curcuma involucrata
intro: Curcuma involucrata, commonly known as Black Turmeric, is a plant species within the Zingiberaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Curcuma involucrata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include curcuminoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
